concerns.text: Task T009 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it writes to the same `autocorrelation_stats.csv` file that T008 produces. Since T009 updates the CSV in‑place, it must run after T008 and cannot be safely executed in parallel with it. The `[P]` tag is therefore inaccurate.

Task T008 generates `autocorrelation_stats.csv` which is subsequently modified by T009. To avoid race conditions, T008 and T009 should be sequenced explicitly (T008 → T009) and the `[P]` tag should be removed from at least one of them.
